segments.mn72:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn72:2.1: Atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.mn72:2.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn72:3.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama,‘sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi [evaṃdiṭṭhī (sī. syā. kaṃ. ka.)] bhavaṃ gotamo”ti?
segments.mn72:4.1: “Kiṃ pana, bho gotama,‘asassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo”ti?
segments.mn72:5.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama,‘antavā loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo”ti?
segments.mn72:6.1: “Kiṃ pana, bho gotama,‘anantavā loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo”ti?
segments.mn72:7.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama,‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo”ti?
segments.mn72:7.4: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’”ti.
segments.mn72:8.1: “Kiṃ pana, bho gotama,‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo”ti?
segments.mn72:8.4: ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’”ti.
segments.mn72:9.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo”ti?
segments.mn72:9.4: ‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’”ti.
segments.mn72:10.1: “Kiṃ pana, bho gotama,‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo”ti?
segments.mn72:10.4: ‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’”ti.
segments.mn72:11.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama,‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo”ti?
segments.mn72:11.4: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’”ti.
segments.mn72:12.1: “Kiṃ pana, bho gotama,‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo”ti?
segments.mn72:12.4: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’”ti.
segments.mn72:13.1: “‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi [moghamaññantīti vadesi (sī.), moghamaññanti iti vadesi (?)].
segments.mn72:13.4: ‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, asassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – asassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:13.7: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, antavā loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – antavā loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:13.10: ‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, anantavā loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – anantavā loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:13.13: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:13.16: ‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:13.19: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:13.22: “‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:13.25: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:13.28: ‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavaṃ gotamo’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:13.31: “Kiṃ pana bho gotamo ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno evaṃ imāni sabbaso diṭṭhigatāni anupagato”ti?
segments.mn72:14.1: “‘Sassato loko’ti kho, vaccha, diṭṭhigatametaṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāro [diṭṭhikantāraṃ (sī. pī.)] diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ sadukkhaṃ savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ, na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.mn72:14.2: ‘Asassato loko’ti kho, vaccha … pe …‘antavā loko’ti kho, vaccha … pe …‘anantavā loko’ti kho, vaccha … pe …‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran’ti kho, vaccha … pe …‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran’ti kho, vaccha … pe …‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti kho, vaccha … pe …‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti kho, vaccha … pe …‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti kho, vaccha … pe …‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti kho, vaccha, diṭṭhigatametaṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ sadukkhaṃ savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ, na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.mn72:14.11: Imaṃ kho ahaṃ, vaccha, ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno evaṃ imāni sabbaso diṭṭhigatāni anupagato”ti.
segments.mn72:15.4: ‘iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo;
segments.mn72:15.5: iti vedanā, iti vedanāya samudayo, iti vedanāya atthaṅgamo;
segments.mn72:15.6: iti saññā, iti saññāya samudayo, iti saññāya atthaṅgamo;
segments.mn72:15.7: iti saṅkhārā, iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo, iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthaṅgamo;
segments.mn72:15.8: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo’ti.
segments.mn72:15.9: Tasmā tathāgato sabbamaññitānaṃ sabbamathitānaṃ sabbaahaṃkāramamaṃkāramānānusayānaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā anupādā vimuttoti vadāmī”ti.
segments.mn72:16.1: “Evaṃ vimuttacitto pana, bho gotama, bhikkhu kuhiṃ upapajjatī”ti?
segments.mn72:16.5: “Tena hi, bho gotama, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī”ti?
segments.mn72:16.6: “Upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti kho, vaccha, na upeti”.
segments.mn72:16.7: “Tena hi, bho gotama, neva upapajjati na na upapajjatī”ti?
segments.mn72:16.8: “Neva upapajjati na na upapajjatīti kho, vaccha, na upeti”.
segments.mn72:17.1: “‘Evaṃ vimuttacitto pana, bho gotama, bhikkhu kuhiṃ upapajjatī’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘upapajjatīti kho, vaccha, na upetī’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:17.2: ‘Tena hi, bho gotama, na upapajjatī’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na upapajjatīti kho, vaccha, na upetī’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:17.3: ‘Tena hi, bho gotama, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti kho, vaccha, na upetī’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:17.4: ‘Tena hi, bho gotama, neva upapajjati na na upapajjatī’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘neva upapajjati na na upapajjatīti kho, vaccha, na upetī’ti vadesi.
segments.mn72:17.5: Etthāhaṃ, bho gotama, aññāṇamāpādiṃ, ettha sammohamāpādiṃ.
segments.mn72:17.6: Yāpi me esā bhoto gotamassa purimena kathāsallāpena ahu pasādamattā sāpi me etarahi antarahitā”ti.
segments.mn72:18.2: Gambhīro hāyaṃ, vaccha, dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
segments.mn72:18.3: So tayā dujjāno aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatrayogena [aññatrāyogena (dī. ni.1.420)] aññatrācariyakena”[aññatthācariyakena (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.mn72:18.4: “Tena hi, vaccha, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi; yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
segments.mn72:19.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vaccha, sace te purato aggi jaleyya, jāneyyāsi tvaṃ –
segments.mn72:19.4: “Sace me, bho gotama, purato aggi jaleyya, jāneyyāhaṃ –
segments.mn72:19.7: ‘yo te ayaṃ purato aggi jalati ayaṃ aggi kiṃ paṭicca jalatī’ti, evaṃ puṭṭho tvaṃ, vaccha, kinti byākareyyāsī”ti?
segments.mn72:19.9: ‘yo te ayaṃ purato aggi jalati ayaṃ aggi kiṃ paṭicca jalatī’ti, evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ, bho gotama, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ –
segments.mn72:19.10: ‘yo me ayaṃ purato aggi jalati ayaṃ aggi tiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca jalatī’”ti.
segments.mn72:19.11: “Sace te, vaccha, purato so aggi nibbāyeyya, jāneyyāsi tvaṃ –
segments.mn72:19.13: “Sace me, bho gotama, purato so aggi nibbāyeyya, jāneyyāhaṃ –
segments.mn72:19.16: ‘yo te ayaṃ purato aggi nibbuto so aggi ito katamaṃ disaṃ gato – puratthimaṃ vā dakkhiṇaṃ vā pacchimaṃ vā uttaraṃ vā’ti, evaṃ puṭṭho tvaṃ, vaccha, kinti byākareyyāsī”ti?
segments.mn72:19.18: “Na upeti, bho gotama, yañhi so, bho gotama, aggi tiṇakaṭṭhupādānaṃ paṭicca ajali [jalati (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] tassa ca pariyādānā aññassa ca anupahārā anāhāro nibbuto tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchatī”ti.
segments.mn72:20.1: “Evameva kho, vaccha, yena rūpena tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya taṃ rūpaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṃkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
segments.mn72:20.2: Rūpasaṅkhayavimutto [rūpasaṅkhāvimutto (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) evaṃ vedanāsaṅkhayādīsupi] kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.mn72:20.4: Upapajjatīti na upeti, na upapajjatīti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti na upeti, neva upapajjati na na upapajjatīti na upeti.
segments.mn72:20.5: “Yāya vedanāya tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya sā vedanā tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.mn72:20.6: Vedanāsaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.mn72:20.8: Upapajjatīti na upeti, na upapajjatīti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti na upeti, neva upapajjati na na upapajjatīti na upeti.
segments.mn72:20.9: “Yāya saññāya tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya sā saññā tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.mn72:20.10: Saññāsaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.mn72:20.12: Upapajjatīti na upeti, na upapajjatīti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti na upeti, neva upapajjati na na upapajjatīti na upeti.
segments.mn72:20.13: “Yehi saṅkhārehi tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya te saṅkhārā tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.mn72:20.14: Saṅkhārasaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.mn72:20.16: Upapajjatīti na upeti, na upapajjatīti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti na upeti, neva upapajjati na na upapajjatīti na upeti.
segments.mn72:20.17: “Yena viññāṇena tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya taṃ viññāṇaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṃkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
segments.mn72:20.18: Viññāṇasaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho – seyyathāpi mahāsamuddo.
segments.mn72:20.20: Upapajjatīti na upeti, na upapajjatīti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti na upeti, neva upapajjati na na upapajjatīti na upeti”.
segments.mn72:21.1: Evaṃ vutte, vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn72:21.2: “seyyathāpi, bho gotama, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahāsālarukkho.
segments.mn72:21.3: Tassa aniccatā sākhāpalāsā palujjeyyuṃ [sākhāpalāsaṃ palujjeyya], tacapapaṭikā palujjeyyuṃ, pheggū palujjeyyuṃ [pheggu palujjeyya (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)];
segments.mn72:21.4: so aparena samayena apagatasākhāpalāso apagatatacapapaṭiko apagataphegguko suddho assa, sāre patiṭṭhito;
segments.mn72:21.5: evameva bhoto gotamassa pāvacanaṃ apagatasākhāpalāsaṃ apagatatacapapaṭikaṃ apagatapheggukaṃ suddhaṃ, sāre patiṭṭhitaṃ.
segments.mn72:22.1: Abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama … pe … upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Tattha na kho ahanti paṭhamavāre nāhaṃ sassatadiṭṭhikoti vadati, dutiye nāhaṃ ucchedadiṭṭhikoti.
Hoti ca na ca hotīti ayaṃ panettha ekaccasassatavādo.
Neva hoti na na hotīti ayaṃ amarāvikkhepoti veditabbo.
Kiñci diṭṭhigatanti kāci ekā diṭṭhipi ruccitvā khamāpetvā gahitā atthīti pucchati.
Tasmāti yasmā pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ udayavayaṃ addasa, tasmā.
Ettha hi ahaṃkāro diṭṭhi, mamaṃkāro taṇhā, mānānusayo māno.
Anupādā vimuttoti catūhi upādānehi kañci dhammaṃ anupādiyitvā vimutto.
Ettha ca “na upapajjatī”ti idaṃ anujānitabbaṃ siyā.

Yasmā pana evaṃ vutte so paribbājako ucchedaṃ gaṇheyya, upapajjatīti pana sassatameva, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatīti ekaccasassataṃ, neva upapajjati na na upapajjatīti amarāvikkhepaṃ, tasmā bhagavā –
“ayaṃ appatiṭṭho anālambo hotu, sukhapavesanaṭṭhānaṃ mā labhatū”ti ananuññāya ṭhatvā anuññampi paṭikkhipi.
Aññatrācariyakenāti paccayākāraṃ ajānantānaṃ aññesaṃ ācariyānaṃ santike vasantena.
Tena hi vacchāti yasmā tvaṃ sammohamāpādinti vadasi, tasmā taṃyevettha paṭipucchissāmi.
Yena rūpenāti yena rūpena sattasaṅkhātaṃ tathāgataṃ rūpīti paññāpeyya.
Seyyathāpi mahāsamuddoti yathā mahāsamuddo gambhīro appameyyo dujjāno, evameva khīṇāsavopi.
Taṃ ārabbha upapajjatītiādi sabbaṃ na yujjati.
Yathā parinibbutaṃ aggiṃ ārabbha puratthimaṃ disaṃ gatotiādi sabbaṃ na yujjati, evaṃ.
Kiñci diṭṭhigatanti imā tāva aṭṭha diṭṭhiyo mā hontu, atthi pana, bho gotama, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhigataṃ gahitaṃ.
Na hi tāya diṭṭhiyā vinā kañci samayaṃ pavattetuṃ yujjatīti adhippāyena pucchati.
Yattha uppajjanti, taṃ sattaṃ mathenti sammaddantīti mathitāti āha “mathitānanti tesaṃyeva vevacanan”ti.
Na upetīti saṅkhaṃ na gacchatīti atthoti āha “na yujjatī”ti.

“Evaṃ vimuttacitto na upapajjatī”ti kāmañcetaṃ sabhāvapavedanaṃ parinibbānaṃ, eke pana ucchedavādino “mayampi ‘satto āyatiṃ na upapajjatī’ti vadāma, samaṇo gotamopi tathā vadatī”ti ucchedabhāveyeva patiṭṭhahissanti, tasmā bhagavā “na upapajjatīti kho vaccha na upetī”ti āha.
Pariyatto pana dhammo atthato paccayākāro evāti āha “dhammoti paccayākāradhammo”ti.
Aññattha payogenāti imamhā niyyānikasāsanā aññasmiṃ micchāsamaye pavattappayogena, aniyyānikaṃ vividhaṃ micchāpaṭipattiṃ paṭipajjantenāti attho.
“Aññavādiyakenā” tipi pāṭho, paccayākārato aññākāradīpakaācariyavādaṃ paggayha tiṭṭhantenāti attho.
Taṃ rūpaṃ tappaṭibaddhasaṃyojanappahānena khīṇāsava- tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ anuppattidhammataṃ āpannaṃ.
Dujjānoti agādhatāya gambhīro “ettakāni udakaḷhakasatānī”tiādinā pametuṃ na sakkāti appameyyo, tato eva dujjāno.

Evamevānti yathā mahāsamuddo gambhīro appameyyo dujjāno, evameva khīṇāsavopi guṇavasena, tasmā ayaṃ rūpādiṃ gahetvā rūpītiādivohāro bhaveyya, parinibbutassa pana tadabhāvā tathā paññāpetuṃ na sakkā, tato taṃ ārabbha upapajjatītiādi na yujjeyya.
Yathā pana vijjamāno eva jātavedo byattena purisena nīyamāno puratthimādidisaṃ gatoti vucceyya, na nibbuto, evaṃ khīṇāsavopīti dassento “evamevā”tiādimāha.
Tena yathā so sālarukkho sākhāpalāsādiasārāpagamena suddho sāre patiṭṭhito, evamayaṃ dhammavinayo sāsavasaṅkhātaasāravigamena lokuttaradhammasāre patiṭṭhitoti dasseti.
